# `datasets/` — generated by the scripts (do not fill by hand)

This folder is **empty in the repository** and must stay so: no image, mask or subject list
is redistributed. It is **written by the preparation scripts** from the raw downloads in
`data/` (see `data/README.md`), and read by the pipeline.

```
datasets/
├── standardized/<Dataset>/<subject>/anat/
│   ├── <subject>_T1w.nii.gz              ← input image
│   ├── <subject>_T2w.nii.gz              ← infants only, when available
│   └── <subject>_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz  ← reference brain mask (evaluation only)
└── manifests/<Dataset>.csv               ← one row per subject, read by the runners
```

How it is produced:

```bash
python -m scripts.standardize_datasets --datasets BOBs,IBSR18,SynthStrip,FetalFMRI
python -m scripts.prepare_mindboggle101
```

The runners read `datasets/manifests/<Dataset>.csv`, where `<Dataset>` is the name passed
to `--dataset` (for example `BOBs`, `IBSR18`, `Mindboggle101`, `SynthStripInfant`,
`FetalFMRI`). Reference masks are used only to compute metrics, never as inference inputs.
